question.text: Ms. Priya Shah invested INR 5 crore in Satpura Market-Neutral Fund (open-ended Cat III AIF). She submits a redemption request on 1 April for 10,000 units; PPM requires 15-day notice with redemption NAV = NAV on the 16th calendar day from notice. Units redeemed: 10,000. The NAV on 16 April (redemption day) is Rs. 1,180. Exit load (she is past lock-in): 1%. What is the NET redemption payout?

explanation.text: The Logic: Gross redemption = 10,000 units x Rs. 1,180 = INR 1,18,00,000. Exit load 1% = INR 1,18,000. Net = INR 1,18,00,000 - INR 1,18,000 = INR 1,16,82,000. The Trap: Option B ignores the exit load. Option C uses a rounded value or wrong NAV. Option D ADDS 1% instead of subtracting. Note: The workbook (pp. 112, 391) supports PPM-specified redemption/exit-load terms and exit load being applied as a NAV-based charge.
